rows.comment: "Pinned" is vague. Say the markers are on the route.
lineComments: Reword to say the start and finish are marked on the route.
rows.replacement: Start and finish are marked on the route.

rows.comment: Wordy and passive. Name what the user did and the consequence.
rows.replacement: You logged no sets, so there is no load or volume to total.

rows.comment: Fragment with an odd verb ("carried"). Say what is missing.
rows.replacement: This session has no route, or its route has no altitude data.

rows.comment: Explanation is useful, but "expected, not a fault" rebuts a worry nobody raised. State the mechanism and the outcome.
lineComments: Give the cause and the result as one cause-effect sentence.
rows.replacement: Cold narrows the blood vessels the optical sensor reads, so the band often finds no pulse during a cold plunge.

rows.comment: "Ordinary, not a fault" is an unprompted rebuttal. Keep the causes, state the result.
lineComments: List the causes once and state what the band does.
rows.replacement: Heat, sweat and a strap that loosens as you warm up can stop the sensor from detecting a pulse, so the band often finds none during heat sessions.

rows.comment: "and no more" is a flourish. State the number.
lineComments: Plain statement of the amount of data.

rows.comment: "Gaps are expected" is reassurance nobody asked for, and the second clause is convoluted.
lineComments: Keep the count, say what the chart shows.
rows.replacement: The band found a pulse in {have} of {total} minutes. The chart shows only those minutes.

rows.comment: Aphorism. Say what the data is and why it can't be drawn.
lineComments: Replace the line-versus-point quip with the mechanism.
rows.replacement: One minute of heart rate gives a single point, so there is no line to draw.

rows.comment: "Reported nothing" is vague. Name the data.
lineComments: Say what the band did not send.
rows.replacement: The band sent no heart rate during this session.

rows.comment: Em dash and "handed over" metaphor. State the coverage.
lineComments: Split at the dash and say what the percentage covers.
rows.replacement: Partial trace. Heart rate covers {pct}% of these minutes.
